author: ACG
name: StreamWatch
short: Detects when members start or stop streaming.
description: Listens for presence updates and checks the activities array for type 1 (streaming). Announces going live and optionally assigns a live role.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only guild settings (channel and role IDs). No personal user data is persisted.
install_msg: Thanks for installing StreamWatch! Enable the Presence and Server Members intents, then use `[p]streamwatch` to configure.
